questions.stem: This organization promotes the prevention of worplace injury, rehabilitates those who are injured at work and provides compensation to replace workers loss of wages while recovering from injury.
questions.explanation: Section 11.5 Occupational Health and Safety in Tourism: "WorkSafeBC is the provincial organization for occupational health and safety in BC." Its mandate is to "Promote the prevention of workplace injury, illness, and disease", "Rehabilitate those who are injured and provide timely return to work" and "Provide fair compensation to replace workers’ loss of wages while recovering from injuries".

"A typical risk analysis compares the probability (frequency) of any risks occurring by the consequence (severity) if they do occur."

questions.stem: When choosing a genre, which of the following questions should you ask yourself?
choices: How quickly does my audience need this information?
How does my audience expect to receive this information?
What way is this information normally sent in my organization?
questions.explanation: Section "Reviewing CMAPP": "Here are some questions you can ask yourself before you choose a genre: How quickly does my audience need this information? How does my audience expect to receive this information? How will my audience use this information? ... What way is this information normally sent in my organization?"
